Lean.logInfo.code:
Lean.logInfo {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [MonadLog m] [AddMessageContext m] [MonadOptions m] (msgData : MessageData) :
  m Unit
Lean.logInfo.comment: Log a new information message using the given message data. The position is provided by `getRef`.
Lean.logInfo.fullDefinition: def logInfo (msgData : MessageData) : m Unit :=   log msgData MessageSeverity.information
Lean.logInfo.description: A method for logging an informational message in a monadic context, utilizing the provided message data and position information.

Lean.logWarningAt.code:

Lean.logWarning.code:
Lean.logWarning {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [MonadLog m] [AddMessageContext m] [MonadOptions m]
  (msgData : MessageData) : m Unit
Lean.logWarning.comment: Log a new warning message using the given message data. The position is provided by `getRef`.
Lean.logWarning.fullDefinition: def logWarning [MonadOptions m] (msgData : MessageData) : m Unit := do   log msgData (if warningAsError.get (← getOptions) then .error else .warning)
Lean.logWarning.description: A method for logging a warning message in a monadic context using the specified message data and position information.
